title: CASI: Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval

paragraphs.en: Large language models increasingly generate multiple retrieval actions jointly, while downstream systems often provide only one reward for the resulting set. Broadcasting this reward provides a valid score-function gradient estimator for the expected set-level objective, but does not determine a coalition-dependent within-set attribution. We introduce CASI (Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval), which constructs the missing counterfactual information through snapshot-grounded set intervention: generate and retrieve once, hold replayable snapshot components fixed, and evaluate alternative subsets under common conditions. Shapley aggregation converts these marginals into within-set credit, which bounded zero-sum advantage shaping incorporates into policy optimization. For m ≥ 4 m\geq 4 , singleton, leave-one-out, and full-set endpoints do not generally determine the Shapley allocation; under additive set values, extra coalition evaluations are redundant. In a five-action sponsored-search setting, exhaustive auction replay over 1,200 requests reveals substantial coalition dependence. Under the training-time evaluator, CASI achieves the highest median cosine similarity to a replay-defined Shapley reference among evaluated credit rules; under a sensitivity backend, CASI does not outperform Singleton. Across five independent training runs, CASI-trained policies achieve higher held-out auction-replay set value than Singleton- or Broadcast-trained policies. In a randomized seven-day production A/B test on 10% of traffic, the CASI-trained policy yields an observed 3.51% lift in the primary advertiser-value metric over production control.

paragraphs.en: LLM-based retrieval systems increasingly generate multiple retrieval actions for a single input, for example by decomposing a question or producing parallel rewrites that cover different facets of an information need ( Tan et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Post-training on downstream outcomes directly optimizes what the system ultimately delivers rather than surface similarity alone ( Jin et al., 2025 ) . This challenge is especially pronounced in sponsored search, where several rewrites retrieve candidate ads whose pools are merged before downstream ranking and auction. An action that is useful alone may become redundant, or compete with candidates from other rewrites, once the pools are combined. In our setting, individual actions do not receive separately observed downstream outcomes; only the realized action set receives an observed reward. This raises a central question: when multiple retrieval actions jointly determine one outcome, what information is needed to construct context-dependent attribution within the realized set?
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型的检索系统越来越多地针对单个输入生成多个检索动作，例如通过分解问题或生成覆盖信息需求不同方面的并行改写（Tan 等人，2026；Zhao 等人，2025；Zheng 等人，2026）。 对下游结果进行后训练可以直接优化系统最终提供的结果，而不仅仅是表面相似性（Jin 等人，2025）。 这一挑战在赞助搜索中尤为突出，因为多个改写会检索候选广告，而这些广告的池会在下游排序和拍卖之前合并。 一个单独使用时有用的动作，在广告池合并后可能会变得多余，或者与其他改写产生的候选广告产生竞争。 在我们的设定中，单个动作不会获得独立观测到的下游结果；只有实际执行的动作集合才能获得观测到的奖励。 这引出了一个核心问题：当多个检索动作共同决定一个结果时，需要在已执行的动作集合内部构建上下文相关的归因，需要哪些信息？

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold. First, we formalize the information gap between valid set-level optimization and coalition-based within-set attribution for jointly generated retrieval actions. We show that, for m ≥ 4 m\geq 4 , singleton, leave-one-out, and full-set endpoint observations do not generally determine the Shapley allocation, while under additive set values additional coalition evaluations are redundant. Second, we introduce snapshot-grounded set intervention to construct comparable coalition evaluations within a realized action set while holding replayable snapshot components fixed. Shapley weighting aggregates these evaluations into action-level credit, and bounded zero-sum advantage shaping incorporates the relative credit into policy optimization. Third, we evaluate CASI through coalition structure, credit-rule alignment with the replay-defined Shapley reference, held-out policy value across independent training runs, and randomized production deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面。 首先，我们将有效集合级优化与联合生成的检索行动中基于联盟的集合内归因之间的信息差距形式化。 我们证明，当 m ≥ 4 时，单元素、留一法以及完整集合的终点观测通常无法确定沙普利分配；而在集合值具有可加性的情况下，额外的联盟评估是冗余的。 其次，我们引入基于快照的集合干预方法，在已实现的行动集合内构建可比较的联盟评估，同时保持可重播的快照组件固定不变。 沙普利加权将这些评估聚合为行动级的信用分配，而有界零和优势塑造则将相对信用纳入策略优化中。 第三，我们通过联盟结构、与重播定义的沙普利参考相一致的信用规则对齐、独立训练运行中的保留策略值以及随机化的生产部署来评估 CASI。

paragraphs.en: LLMs increasingly learn retrieval actions from downstream outcomes rather than surface similarity. Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025 ) trains multi-turn search with reinforcement learning, while RAG-R1 ( Tan et al., 2026 ) and parallel-search methods ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) extend this paradigm to multiple queries or parallel decomposition. Outcome-based post-training typically assigns supervision at the response or trajectory level: GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) derives a scalar group-relative advantage for each sampled response, whereas process supervision provides finer feedback along a reasoning trajectory ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) . These methods refine where supervision is assigned across responses or trajectories. Our setting concerns a different axis: several retrieval actions are generated jointly within one response and share one downstream outcome, raising the question of what counterfactual information is needed for context-dependent attribution within the realized action set.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地从下游结果中学习检索操作，而非依赖表面相似性。 Search-R1（Jin 等，2025）通过强化学习训练多轮搜索，而 RAG-R1（Tan 等，2026）和并行搜索方法（Zhao 等，2025）则将该范式扩展到多个查询或并行分解。 基于结果的后续训练通常在响应或轨迹层面分配监督：GRPO（Shao 等，2024）为每个采样响应计算一个标量形式的组内相对优势，而过程监督则在推理轨迹上提供更精细的反馈（Lightman 等，2024）。 这些方法优化了监督在响应或轨迹之间的分配位置。 我们的设定关注一个不同的维度：多个检索操作在一次响应中协同生成，并共享一个下游结果，由此引出了一个问题：在已实现的行动集合内，针对上下文相关的归因，需要哪些反事实信息？

paragraphs.en: Shared-reward credit assignment is well studied in cooperative reinforcement learning. COMA constructs an agent-specific counterfactual baseline by marginalizing one agent’s action while holding others fixed ( Foerster et al., 2018 ) . Standard difference rewards instead remove or replace one agent ( Wolpert & Tumer, 2001 ) . Value-decomposition methods impose structure on joint value, additively in VDN ( Sunehag et al., 2018 ) and monotonically in QMIX ( Rashid et al., 2018 ) . Shapley-based methods aggregate marginal contributions across coalitions and have also been used for policy learning ( Li et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2020 ) . Slate off-policy evaluation provides another structural precedent, recovering per-slot components from slate-level feedback under a specified model ( Swaminathan et al., 2017 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 共享奖励的信用分配在合作强化学习中得到了广泛研究。 COMA 通过固定其他智能体的动作，仅对某一智能体的动作进行边缘化，从而构建出该智能体特定的反事实基线（Foerster et al., 2018）。 标准的差异奖励方法则是移除或替换某一智能体（Wolpert & Tumer, 2001）。 价值分解方法对联合价值施加结构：在 VDN 中采用加法结构（Sunehag et al., 2018），在 QMIX 中采用单调结构（Rashid et al., 2018）。 基于沙普利值的方法会汇总不同联盟中的边际贡献，并且也被用于策略学习（Li et al., 2021; Wang et al., 2020）。 石板式离策略评估提供了另一种结构上的先例：在指定模型下，从石板级反馈中恢复每个时间步的组成部分（Swaminathan et al., 2017）。

The methodological gap in our setting is the counterfactual object on which cross-context within-set credit can be computed. Slate decomposition relies on an additive conditional-mean reward model, whereas retrieved candidate pools in our setting are merged and jointly processed by a nonlinear, capacity-limited downstream system. COMA marginalizes one action against a fixed configuration of the others, and a standard difference reward uses a chosen removal or replacement counterfactual. paragraphs.en: Our distinction is therefore not the Shapley weighting itself, but the snapshot-grounded construction of comparable coalition evaluations for parameter-shared LLM retrieval actions, without requiring an agent-wise critic or a factored value model.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们的区别并不在于沙普利权重本身，而在于为共享参数的 LLM 检索操作构建基于快照的可比较联盟评估，而无需每个智能体都配备一个批评者或因子化价值模型。

paragraphs.en: Sponsored-search retrieval has evolved from query substitution and dense retrieval toward generative and value-aware rewriting. Prior work includes relevance–revenue trade-offs ( Radlinski et al., 2008 ) , diversity-aware RL rewriting ( Mohankumar et al., 2021 ) , hybrid generative and dense retrieval ( Mohankumar et al., 2023 ) , contextual retrieval ( Grbovic et al., 2015 ) , and value-aware LLM rewriting ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Our focus is complementary: these lines improve how rewrites are produced or scored, whereas we study within-set credit after several rewrites are issued jointly and their candidate pools are merged, deduplicated, ranked, and selected together. In this capacity-limited regime, a response-level outcome does not by itself determine attribution among parallel actions, and an action’s marginal value need not be invariant to the surrounding action set.
paragraphs.zh: 赞助搜索检索已从查询替换和密集检索，逐步发展为生成式和价值感知的重写。 先前的研究包括相关性-收益权衡（Radlinski 等人，2008）、考虑多样性的强化学习重写（Mohankumar 等人，2021）、混合生成式和密集检索（Mohankumar 等人，2023）、上下文检索（Grbovic 等人，2015）以及价值感知的 LLM 重写（Zhang 等人，2026）。 我们的研究重点与之互补：这些方法旨在改进重写的生成或评分方式，而我们则研究在多个重写被联合发出、其候选池被合并、去重、排序并共同选择之后，集合内部的贡献度分配问题。 在这种能力受限的情况下，响应层面的结果本身并不能决定并行动作之间的归属，且一个动作的边际价值也未必对周围的动作集合保持不变。

paragraphs.en: We study policy optimization for jointly generated retrieval actions under set-level feedback. CASI ( Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval ) constructs alternative coalition evaluations within each realized action set while holding replayable snapshot components fixed. Shapley weighting aggregates the resulting contextual marginals, and bounded zero-sum advantage shaping maps their relative credit to action-level advantages.

paragraphs.en: We study context-dependent within-set credit for jointly generated retrieval actions under set-level feedback. CASI constructs comparable coalition evaluations through snapshot-grounded set intervention, aggregates contextual marginals with Shapley weighting, and incorporates their relative credit through bounded zero-sum advantage shaping. We show that endpoint observations do not in general determine the Shapley allocation for m ≥ 4 m\geq 4 , while additional coalition evaluations are redundant under additive set values. In a five-action sponsored-search setting, CASI achieves the largest median cosine similarity to the replay-defined Shapley reference under the deployed training evaluator, improves held-out auction-replay set value across independent training runs, and yields an observed 3.51 % 3.51\% advertiser-value lift over production control in a randomized A/B test. Backend sensitivity further shows that additional coalition information does not guarantee improved credit alignment under every evaluator. These results support snapshot-grounded set intervention as a practical approach to within-set supervision when retrieval actions interact.

paragraphs.en: CASI attributes downstream value within a fixed generated action set. It does not attempt to identify the generation-time causal effect by which an early autoregressive action may change which later actions are emitted.
